formRaceEntries.comment: Raced on the speed & fought on well to score here last time. Up in trip for this but he's drawn well.
Resumes for new stable (ex C Jokic). 3rd/6 in a Bendigo jumpout & races best this trip. Betting?

formRaceEntries.comment: Had every chance but not disgraced in this class at Ararat 2nd-up. Fitter again & drawn to have every chance.
Never on the track when resuming and it was a good effort considering. Game Bairnsdale third second up last prep.
Gave too much start when back in class here last time. Drops again in class for this & blinkers back on.

Ran a better race last start and has been in the placings here. Trifecta hope.
Raced wide & tried hard when not far away last time. This might be a bit easier & blinkers off for this.
